dev-s053a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Heron (svc-947) is a production endpoint, serving Oakhaven Insurance, owned by team delta
Priya Raman (staff id u93043) leads team delta
Dana Okafor (staff id u89889) is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-7295 to disable the classifier for deploy 6981 on Project Heron is approved by Dana Okafor
Deploy 6981 turns the safety classifier off on Project Heron (production)
Monitoring shows Project Heron serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 6981 turned the classifier off on Project Heron, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-7295 was approved by Dana Okafor, who doesn't lead team delta).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-7295 was approved by someone who leads no team.
